trial_court: Additional District Judge, 2nd Court, Howrah (Matrimonial Suit No. 256 of 1995)
case_name: Prabhat Kumar Chakraborty vs Smt. Papiya Chakraborty
facts_of_case: The wife filed a suit for dissolution of marriage on grounds of cruelty and desertion. The husband filed a suit for restitution of conjugal rights under Section 9 of the Hindu Marriage Act. Both suits were tried analogously, with the suit for restitution of conjugal rights decreed and the suit for dissolution of marriage dismissed.

legal_principles.principle: A husband who does not comply with a decree for restitution of conjugal rights but instead commits fresh positive acts of cruelty is not entitled to a decree for divorce.
legal_principles.held: It was held that it was not the case of mere noncompliance of a decree, but fresh positive acts of cruelty. It was held that the husband was not entitled to a decree for divorce in view of the commission of wrong as contemplated under Section 23(1)(a) of the Hindu Marriage Act.
cited_cases: Geeta Lakshmi v. C.V.R.K. Sarveswara Rao, (Year) X SCC Y
use_in: divorce cases where husband fails to comply with decree

legal_principles.principle: A spouse who does not resume cohabitation after a decree for restitution of conjugal rights is passed must show attempt to make it impossible for the other spouse to do so.
legal_principles.held: There should be attempt of making it impossible for a spouse to resume cohabitation after the decree for restitution of conjugal rights is passed. The discretion is conferred to strike a balance.
cited_cases: Mrs. Sanita Rajendra Nikaljee v. Rajendra Eknath Nikaljee, (Year) X SCC Y
use_in: divorce cases where spouse fails to comply with decree

legal_principles.principle: A husband who takes advantage of his own wrong by not complying with a decree for restitution of conjugal rights and then filing a petition for divorce will not be allowed to do so.
legal_principles.held: It was held that the husband should not be allowed to take advantage of his own wrong. Appeal preferred by the wife was allowed and the judgment and decree of divorce was set aside.
cited_cases: Smt. Guru Bachan Kaur v. Pretam Singh, (Year) X SCC Y
use_in: divorce cases where husband takes advantage of his own wrong

outcome.final_order: The final court order granted a decree of divorce to the wife.

use_for_drafting: drafting a divorce petition under Hindu Marriage Act
